hero.bio: IT professional with over 14 years of experience, specializing in systems analysis, technical support, and project management. Working in global corporate environments focused on troubleshooting, incident resolution, and process optimization.
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.p1: I currently work as a Software Support Engineer at Wiley, focused on technical support for enterprise applications, ensuring the stability and operational continuity of critical business platforms.
about.p2: My professional journey includes experience at global companies such as Anheuser-Busch InBev, CrossKnowledge, and Venturus (Ingenico), where I developed expertise in complex incident analysis, advanced troubleshooting, and technical team leadership.
about.p3: Passionate about technology and education, I developed innovative projects such as an Educational Robotics solution using Arduino and S4A, implemented in public schools, and automation systems for the healthcare sector.
